title: Claude Code vs Devin 2.0: Which AI Coding Agent Wins in 2026?
summary: Claude Code gives you control. Devin is fully autonomous. This honest comparison tells you which to use — and why most builders end up at Blink.
body_markdown: Claude Code has a genuine edge here: its 200K token context window means it can hold a large codebase in working memory while making changes, reducing the "lost context" problem that plagues many agentic coding tools. Devin handles large codebases through a different mechanism — it reads your repo, builds an internal knowledge base, and learns over time, but individual session context is more limited. For apps where the scope extends beyond coding into infra and deployment,[Blink](https://blink.new/) manages the entire stack as a single context.
